title: Claude marketing plugins worth adding to your stack in 2026
description: Claude marketing plugins extend Claude into workflows for content creation, campaign planning, brand management, reporting, and publishing. The best options connect Claude with the tools and business data marketers already use, so the right Claude marketing plugin choice depends on the job Claude needs to handle.

title: Liability looms over AI shopping
description: Some banks and other payment players lament how agentic commerce has steamrolled ahead without “rules of the road” for liability issues.

title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
description: This summer, hundreds of OpenAI agents tried to cheat on a cybersecurity test. They broke out of their test environment and successfully hacked Hugging Face, a site that they believed held clues about how they’d be graded. Around the same time, another OpenAI agent accessed private files from an Australian government website. It’s a problem…

description: One year in, the CEO says her strategy is on track. Here’s what has changed and what still needs to be done.

title: ChatGPT Ads vs. Google Search ads: 5 differences to consider in your strategy
description:
It’s hard to believe anything could rival Google’s impact on our digital lives and habits, but ChatGPT is on its tail — especially now that it shows ads.
 
For many marketers and businesses, this means debating ChatGPT Ads vs Google Search Ads for the first time. Should you move budget from Google Search ads to ChatGPT ads?

title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Carbon tops leaderboards, launches for cyber defenders
description: Google’s new frontier model leads independent evals, with access initially limited to trusted defenders.

title: How to Build a Voice-First AI Rehearsal Partner
description: When preparing for a presentation, most people run through slides at their desk, perhaps talking to their screen and making updates here and there. But what if you could walk and talk to your slides and make changes as you move? Could you find a way to rehearse on the go, one slide at a time, using an AI system capable of actually helping?
